findings: Prydaz native driver 207428 triggers shield 207472 every 30000 ms; shield is 25% max health before normal absorb modifiers, 15% for tank specs, lasts 30000 ms and covers school mask 127. Existing base amount calculation was correct; added null-caster protection.

Generic school/mana shield bypass wrongly reduced shield capacity rather than reserving part of the hit. Large shields could absorb an entire small hit despite bypass. Reserve bypassed damage once across both loops, then restore it before split damage.

DamageInfo::ModifyDamage previously capped positive changes by remaining damage and could not restore bypassed damage from zero. Clamp the signed change in a wide intermediate instead. Existing callers checked: Ascendant Council damage-halving and new bypass transfers.
Old Norgannon stationary poll cast 234797 every 3000 ms, whose linked rows immediately granted a 4000-ms movement buff. It did not wait six seconds or defer the four-second timer until movement.

New 236373 AuraScript observes continuous stillness and transitions every update, uses native class-specific 236380/236430/236431, suppresses the old periodic action, and cleans helper auras on removal/re-equip/login. Migration removes the eight superseded SQL rows and binds the driver.

SendMovieStart now rejects movie 474 while a movie is already active, in addition to the quest checkpoint guard. The exact original repeat source remains unconfirmed because the old running revision did not log movie starts/completions.
